name: claude-code-plugins
description: Development tooling for the plugins in this marketplace. Not part of any plugin; users install none of it.

scripts.eval: cd plugins/linear-workflow && rm -rf evals/results/latest; claude plugin eval . -j 4 --ablation none --allow-tools Bash --scaffold --trust-plugin --no-publish --output-dir evals/results/latest; node evals/report.mjs evals/results/latest/aggregate-result.json
